scope: Read-only independent review of first-behavior audio selection; static inspection only, no added test count.
checks: New first-creation audio catalog ownership is isolated from saved-behavior audio brands.
Origin capture, world/base revision and saved scene pins precede catalog availability.
Native audio declaration validation remains authoritative; choices identify tracks, not repeated resource IDs.
Insertion requires an explicitly selected existing String and updates only its exact source token.
Before insertion, the UI rereads the saved directory and rejects changed origin, owner, source, binding, parameter content, or explicit control selections.
Directory loading, selection, rejected or late requests, same-value fills and input budgets do not write author files or obtain creation authority.
limitations: This static review is not a substitute for the named unit cases, actual browser authoring or real native playback validation.
